svg.text: WOODEX OS — the Reimagin master admin
One Laravel application · one database · commerce + CMS + CRM + AI · Hostinger shared, no VPS
admin.woodex.pk — one sidebar for every role, filtered by permission
catalog to refund, in one place
no second app, no sync job
Commerce → Dashboard — the same Livewire shell as the rest of the admin
nine surfaces that today end in a toast — after: a record in the OS
one application — the storefront is a skin, the OS is the brain
Bagisto is not run — its feature set is the spec and its MIT-licensed money algorithms are ported. See COMMERCE-IN-OS.md.
